notes: Known partial: per-order classification by exhaustive computation (J. Myers, polyomino.org.uk, extended by P. Church) with counts in OEIS A054359/A054360 to n = 25 (unrefereed). No general criterion; decidability of monotile polyomino tiling with isometries is open (translations only: Beauquier-Nivat). Outside Lean: everything (citation).
